items.title: MINOR: Stop staging LICENSE/NOTICE into kafka-site content dir
items.body:
Follow-up to KAFKA-21289 (#23833), which fixed `release.py stage-docs`
for the Hugo-based kafka-site layout.

The site-docs tar carries the repo's top-level `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` at
its root. `stage-docs` extracts the tar with `tar xf ...
--strip-components 1` straight into `content/en/<version>/`, so those
two files get dumped into the  kafka-site content tree alongside the
actual docs. They are not docs content and do not belong there — the
previous release slot (`content/en/43`) has neither, and the javadoc
tree already carries its own `legal/` license files under
`static/<version>/javadoc/`.

This was flagged on the 4.4 kafka-site PR, where `content/en/44/LICENSE`
and `content/en/44/NOTICE` showed up as spurious additions and had to be
removed by hand. Without this change they return on every `stage-docs`
run.

This patch drops `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` from the content directory after
extraction, mirroring the existing post-extraction cleanup that moves
`images/` out to `static/<version>/`.

No behavior change for any other staged file.

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>

items.title: KAFKA-21289: Fix release.py stage-docs for Hugo kafka-site
items.body:
Changes

- swaps the sentinel check to `hugo.yaml` instead of `owered-by.html`
- splits the extraction: markdown goes to `content/en/<version>`,
javadoc goes to `static/<version>`
- the site-docs tar bundles images in alongside the markdown, so those
get pulled out of `content/en/<version>/images` and moved into
`static/<version>/images` right after extraction — otherwise they’d sit
in the wrong place. NOTE: I hardcoded `images` as the one directory that
needs pulling out of `content/<version>` — based on what’s actually in
the tar now and what the existing slots look like. Any future doc change
bundling some other asset directory into the tar won’t be caught by
this.

- fixed a small pre-existing bug while I was in there: the sentinel
failure message was missing an `f` prefix, so it was printing
`{kafka_site_repo_path}` literally instead of the actual path

Testing
- Ran stage-docs locally twice against `4.4.0`, staged into a real
Hugo-based kafka-site clone. `content/en/44` and `static/44` come out
matching exactly what the `4.0`, `4.3.0`, and `4.3.1` slots already look
like — same top-level structure. `4.4.0` docs are published as part of
[kafka-site#925](https://github.com/apache/kafka-site/pull/925 )

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>

items.title: MINOR: Install gnupg2 in native Docker image build
items.body:
The native Docker image build fails with "gpg: command not found" (exit
code 127) when verifying the downloaded release tarball's signature.
https://github.com/apache/kafka/actions/runs/35000209182/job/104486450640

This is a regression from KAFKA-20314 (#22059), which switched the
native image base from ghcr.io/graalvm/graalvm-community:21 to :25 to
fix an intermittent startup segfault. That base image swap was otherwise
correct, but graalvm-community:25 does not bundle gnupg the way :21 did,
so the existing `gpg --import` / `gpg --batch --verify` steps in the
Dockerfile now fail before the native-image compilation ever runs.

Fix by installing gnupg2   Verified locally: native image now builds and
boots successfully against the 4.4.0-rc1 artifacts, including signature
verification.

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>, Gaurav Narula
 <gaurav_narula2@apple.com>

items.title: KAFKA-10551: Add topic id support to produce request and response
items.body:
- Add support topicId in `ProduceRequest`/`ProduceResponse`. Topic name
and Topic Id will become `ignorable` following the footstep of
`FetchRequest`/`FetchResponse`
- ReplicaManager still look for `HostedPartition` using `TopicPartition`
and doesn't check topic id. This is an **[OPEN QUESTION]** if we should
address this in this pr or wait for
[KAFKA-16212](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-16212) as this
will update `ReplicaManager::getPartition` to use `TopicIdParittion`
once we update the cache. Other option is that we compare provided
`topicId` with `Partition` topic id and return `UNKNOW_TOPIC_ID` or
`UNKNOW_TOPIC_PARTITION` if we can't find partition with matched topic
id.

items.title: KAFKA-15363: Broker log directory failure changes
items.body:
- Extend the ReplicaAlterLogDirsThread to send an AssignReplicasToDirsRequestData RPC before promoting the future replica in JBOD mode with KRAFT. 
- Extend AssignmentsManager and DirectoryEventHandler to attach a callback to the events which will run when the RPC is completed. 
- The state of RPCs is kept in memory in ReplicaAlterLogDirsThread, and it gets updated using the callback that is sent to AssignmentsManager. Once we promote the future replica we clear the state of the RPCs related to this replica in question 

_**Update:**_
- During cancellation of the assignment if the ReplicaAlterLogDirsThread had already sent RPC for queuing then it will fire the revert assignment first before it removes the fetch state of this partition.

items.title: KAFKA-14596: Move TopicCommand to tools
items.body:
This pr include 
- The changes include switching Scala code to java
- Move TopicCommand and all test cases to tools

Some implementation notes:
- I added `ToolsTestUtils.createBrokerProperties` as a wrapper for `TestUtils.createBrokerConfig` to avoid converting between `Map<Integer, String>` and `Map<Int, String>`.
- Replicated `TestUtils.setReplicationThrottleForPartitions` and `TestUtils.removeReplicationThrottleForPartitions` to `ToolsTestUtils` as the methods are used only `TopicCommandIntegrationTest` and `ReassignPartitionsIntegrationTest`. We need to remove it from `TestUtils` once we migrate `ReassignPartitions`
- Replicated `TestInfoUtils.TestWithParameterizedQuorumName` to `ToolsTestUtils` as java convert this into a getter function which cannot be used with `ParameterizedTest`
- Move `CoreUtils.duplicate` to `ToolsUtils`
- <del>Move `TopicFilter` out of core. (This is part of https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-14647 which seems not moving for a while  )</del> Used #13158 
- <del>Duplicate `AdminCommandFailedException` and `AdminOperationException` out of core. </del> Used the new exceptions from #13278
